title: R25 WrappedVault family (Pharos): $169.4M is manager-reported NAV, zero on-chain USDC

prior_closure.claim: Manager-set NAV; 0 USDC held; role-gated updates

contradiction_resolution: ca2-recon summed totalAssets() (share supply x manager NAV / 1e13) and labelled it USDC held. balanceOf(vault) is 0 for all five vaults at blocks 19M, 20M, 21M, 22M and 22,019,671. The token is genuine Pharos USDC; nothing is held.
closed_reasons: All five vaults hold 0 of asset 0xC879C018dB60520F4355C26eD1a6D572cdAC1815 at every block checked (19,000,000 / 20,000,000 / 21,000,000 / 22,000,000 / 22,019,671).
totalAssets() = totalSupply() * latestNav() / 1e13; latestNav is written only by handleOracleReport(), gated to ORACLE_REPORTER_ROLE (single EOA 0xa33b05f6..., 1 report/day, +/-10% cap).
Claimed AUM $169,413,236.72 is 14.38x the entire Pharos USDC supply ($11,779,172.72 at the pinned block), so it cannot be on-chain USDC.
whitelistEnabled()=1 and isWhitelisted(attacker)=0; deposit/mint/requestRedeem/redeem/withdraw/handleOracleReport all revert from an unprivileged EOA.
requestRedeem enforces msg.sender == owner and cancelRedeemRequest enforces owner; attacker cannot claim the escrow's 86.35% of VRPCQ.
Swaper, withdraw queue, custodians, escrow and implementations hold 0 USDC; the shared escrow holds 1 wei of dust.
Swap.withdrawByAgent is role-gated: attacker revert selector 0xe2517d3f (OZ AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount); the vRPCQ vault address passes auth and fails later.
No funded external holder grants the swaper or queue an allowance; the only allowance to a vault is a shareholder's own 698,360.32 USDC deposit approval, not consumable by a third party.
